sample_unit: chatbot outputs (3 chatbots x 4 end-of-life terms), each scored by six physicians

links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid grade level) of chatbot definitions of end-of-life terms
links.effect: Mean FRE 41.7 and mean grade level 14.1, indicating low readability.
links.quote: The mean FRE score was 41.7, and the mean grade level was 14.1, indicating low readability.

links.outcome: Physician-rated credibility of references provided by chatbots
links.effect: Credibility was low with a mean score of 3 (1.8) on a 0-10 scale.
links.quote: Credibility was low with a mean score of 3 (1.8).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of three LLM chatbots defining end-of-life care concepts, rated by physicians for accuracy, comprehensiveness, credibility, and readability. It does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
